opentargets.name: skin and soft tissue Staphylococcus aureus infection
opentargets.description: Staphylococcus aureus infection that occurs specifically in skin or soft tissue and manifests through a specific range of symptoms including but not necesarrily limited to erysipelas, cellulitis, abscesses, mastitis, carbuncle and furuncle, acute lymphadenitis, impetigo, folliculitis and hidradenitis
